definition.def: If you require something or if something is required, you need it or it is necessary. [formal]
examples: If you require further information, you should consult the registrar. [VERB noun]
This isn't the kind of crisis that requires us to drop everything else. [VERB noun to-infinitive]
Some of the materials required for this technique may be difficult to obtain. [VERB-ed]

definition.def: If a law or rule requires you to do something, you have to do it. [formal]
examples: The rules also require employers to provide safety training. [VERB noun to-infinitive]
At least 35 manufacturers have flouted a law requiring prompt reporting of such malfunctions. [VERB noun]
The law requires that employees are given the opportunity to improve their performance before they are dismissed. [VERB that]
Then he'll know exactly what's required of him. [be VERB-ed + of]

definition.def: If you say that something is required reading for a particular group of people, you mean that you think it is essential for them to read it because it will give them information which they should have.
examples: It is an important report that should be required reading for every MP. [+ for]
